queries.name: iscam_origen_agosto_runtime_vs_detalle_diario
queries.sql: WITH runtime AS ( SELECT CAST(fecha_operacion AS date) AS fecha_operacion, SUM(CAST(ISNULL(ventas_total,0) AS decimal(19,4))) AS ventas_runtime, SUM(CAST(ISNULL(tickets_total,0) AS bigint)) AS tickets_runtime, SUM(CAST(ISNULL(pax_total,0) AS bigint)) AS pax_runtime FROM dbo.vw_Comercial_KPIs_Diarios_v2_Runtime WHERE unidad_negocio_id='ORIGEN' AND fecha_operacion>='2026-08-01' AND fecha_operacion<'2026-09-01' GROUP BY CAST(fecha_operacion AS date) ), detalle_ticket AS ( SELECT CAST(fecha_operacion AS date) AS fecha_operacion, numero_ticket, SUM(CAST(ISNULL(importe_neto,0) AS decimal(19,4))) AS ventas_ticket, MAX(CAST(ISNULL(pax,0) AS bigint)) AS pax_ticket FROM dbo.Comercial_Inteligencia_VentasDetalleProducto WHERE unidad_negocio_id='ORIGEN' AND fecha_operacion>='2026-08-01' AND fecha_operacion<'2026-09-01' AND ISNULL(activo,1)=1 AND ISNULL(es_kpi_valido,1)=1 GROUP BY CAST(fecha_operacion AS date), numero_ticket ), detalle AS ( SELECT fecha_operacion, SUM(ventas_ticket) AS ventas_detalle, COUNT(*) AS tickets_detalle, SUM(pax_ticket) AS pax_detalle FROM detalle_ticket GROUP BY fecha_operacion ) SELECT CONVERT(varchar(10),COALESCE(r.fecha_operacion,d.fecha_operacion),120) AS fecha_operacion, ISNULL(r.ventas_runtime,0) AS ventas_runtime, ISNULL(d.ventas_detalle,0) AS ventas_detalle, ISNULL(r.ventas_runtime,0)-ISNULL(d.ventas_detalle,0) AS delta_ventas, ISNULL(r.tickets_runtime,0) AS tickets_runtime, ISNULL(d.tickets_detalle,0) AS tickets_detalle, ISNULL(r.tickets_runtime,0)-ISNULL(d.tickets_detalle,0) AS delta_tickets, ISNULL(r.pax_runtime,0) AS pax_runtime, ISNULL(d.pax_detalle,0) AS pax_detalle, ISNULL(r.pax_runtime,0)-ISNULL(d.pax_detalle,0) AS delta_pax FROM runtime r FULL OUTER JOIN detalle d ON d.fecha_operacion=r.fecha_operacion WHERE ABS(ISNULL(r.ventas_runtime,0)-ISNULL(d.ventas_detalle,0))>0.05 OR ISNULL(r.tickets_runtime,0)<>ISNULL(d.tickets_detalle,0) OR ISNULL(r.pax_runtime,0)<>ISNULL(d.pax_detalle,0) ORDER BY fecha_operacion

queries.name: iscam_origen_agosto_detalle_ajustes_por_dia
queries.sql: SELECT CONVERT(varchar(10),CAST(fecha_operacion AS date),120) AS fecha_operacion, COUNT(*) AS lineas, COUNT(DISTINCT numero_ticket) AS tickets_detalle, SUM(CAST(ISNULL(importe_neto,0) AS decimal(19,4))) AS ventas_detalle, SUM(CASE WHEN producto_codigo_fuente LIKE '__ISCAM_AJUSTE_%' THEN CAST(ISNULL(importe_neto,0) AS decimal(19,4)) ELSE 0 END) AS ajustes_iscam, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN producto_codigo_fuente LIKE '__ISCAM_AJUSTE_%' THEN numero_ticket END) AS tickets_con_ajuste FROM dbo.Comercial_Inteligencia_VentasDetalleProducto WHERE unidad_negocio_id='ORIGEN' AND fecha_operacion>='2026-08-01' AND fecha_operacion<'2026-09-01' AND ISNULL(activo,1)=1 AND ISNULL(es_kpi_valido,1)=1 GROUP BY CAST(fecha_operacion AS date) ORDER BY fecha_operacion

constraints: No ocultar ni desactivar guards de conciliacion
Usar baseline ff11d2e4ce2e248324458206e7ea0b262b29b394 como referencia funcional
La salida debe proponer un solo parche determinista posterior, no una cadena de experimentos
